The user authorized independent randomized complex reference-guided keyword tests. This arm selects a rooftop printmaking material-comparison pause with a rising lantern, independently drawn from general-knowledge lists. It is an agent-authored synthetic qualification direction, not user-supplied expression, emotion, skin or body definitions. The viewer is close enough to read small current facial movements and tactile material states while the studio event and city remain legible. The portrait informs visible face and hair appearance only; the fictional subject is explicitly 29 years old. Pouty lips is tested as current gentle forward lip action rather than increased intrinsic lip volume; side-eye is tested as lateral eye direction rather than judgment; smooth applies separately to a textured-even cheek surface and polished porcelain; supple applies to a leather pouch rim that visibly bends now, without a recovery claim. Subtle everyday attraction is a supporting quality in the close viewing relationship, soft teal drape and reflected skin light. The scene remains ordinarily physical with restrained creative variation.

Photograph an explicitly adult 29-year-old woman in a rooftop printmaking studio above a city market. A paper lantern rises on a taut pulley cord beside a print drying rack, its tassel making a short upward blur above the hanging sheets. She stands beside the waist-high print table, pausing with a palm-sized porcelain oval and a thin dark leather map pouch. Use the supplied portrait's visible facial proportions and short dark bob with wispy fringe as the face-and-hair appearance reference. Her eyes and natural upper-and-lower lip contours retain their reference proportions. Her head stays nearly frontal while both irises turn toward the lantern at her anatomical left, on screen right. Both lips are gently drawn forward into a small compact rounded opening, with softly resting mouth corners. Her cheek surfaces have even soft light transitions and visible fine natural skin texture. Her left hand steadies the pouch against the waist-high print table; her left thumb presses its rim inward into a rounded bend and broad soft folds. Her right palm supports the porcelain oval at chest height, with curled fingers beneath it. The oval has a continuous polished glaze and an even reflected highlight. A muted teal wrap blouse drapes softly across her collarbone. Compose a vertical medium close environmental photograph at eye level, keeping her face, mouth, eyes and both held materials clear at native detail; place the pouch and oval near the same depth plane as her face. Bright midday light passes through a translucent ceiling, with faint rooftop geometry and market awnings beyond the rail. The moment feels quietly attentive, intimate in viewing distance, and tactile, with the moving paper form answering the soft fold below.

definitions.principle: These creative definitions guide agent-owned choices within requester meaning, not clinical classifications. Zero/off disables added treatment, never removes explicitly requested content or artistic judgment. Expression levels describe prominence in the whole image; creativity levels describe interpretive freedom. Neither measures exposure percentages, detail quotas, quality scores, or native image-model parameters. Intensity and expression are separate choices; higher intensity does not prescribe a garment, material or expression category. Creativity leaves style, extra props and surreal treatment open to the request and artistic judgment. Emphasis directs only active sensual and fetish axes without changing their intensities. Popular permits familiar appeal without requiring trend search; overt is an available expression, not the mandatory meaning of level three. Choose a coherent expression suited to this particular scene. Sensual and fetish may share the same expressive choice.
